waive.lint: Enarratio still lints and formats with Biome; its move to the shared Oxlint and Oxfmt configs is its own change, not part of the pr.yml move that brought this rule (devkit 0.25.0) into its checks

copies.src/render/data.ts: toDate reads a chart value (a Date, an ISO string or a timestamp) inside the published library, which takes no runtime dependency on Prelum
copies.src/render/dataset.ts: datasetJsonLd builds the Dataset JSON-LD inside the published library, which cannot import Prelum's ./schema: Prelum depends on enarratio (its chart blocks render through it), so enarratio depending on Prelum would be a dependency cycle
